_not_the_training_set.explanation: dumped 2026-08-26, before a later decontamination pass; it is a STALE SUPERSET. The current mix is 340,850 pairs, and the candidate trained on 338,076 after build_arrays dropped pairs whose every positive was B2-banned. The RELEASED model trained on the clean 338,076 -- this list is used only by the closed-form teacher probes.
_not_the_training_set.consequence: 1.31% of the probe's fit set overlaps the protected-query index (six + dev + untouched-final), so the closed-form tables were fitted on some queries that R1 later removed. Every candidate shares the identical fit set, so the contamination inflates all of them equally: the probe's RANKING -- which is all it is used for, and all its own artifact claims -- is unaffected, while its ABSOLUTE ratios are inflated and may not be quoted as clean. Disclosed rather than repaired because regenerating would break comparability with every committed row; a teacher SWAP would re-run the widened read on a regenerated list.
